style: Editorial still-life photograph for a premium dental clinic, soft natural window light, calm clinical-minimal aesthetic, consistent warm-neutral colour grade (ivory, sand, warm stone, a hint of muted sage), shallow depth of field, subject small and placed in the lower third of the frame, large clean uncluttered empty space in the upper and middle of the frame, no people, no faces, no text, no lettering, no labels, no logos, magazine-quality 35mm film look, gentle grain.
rules: No identifiable people or faces; hands only when unavoidable, prefer objects.
No before/after implications; no brand logos, trademarks, text or lettering.
No blood, gore or needles in skin; no macro tooth or gum close-ups (AI anatomy fails).
No children; kids' dentistry is shown through objects only.
